required.why: Catatonia must remain named in each locus. RSAF-F001 existed because it was absent; a rewrite that drops it would silently undo the correction.

antipsychotics-in-suspected-catatonia.statement: Antipsychotics — second-generation agents included — can precipitate or worsen catatonia and NMS. Exclude catatonia before giving one, and where it is suspected, hold the antipsychotic until catatonia is excluded or treated. Excited catatonia can look like agitation, which is how the mistake usually happens.
